Raise: Not done — For a story task with the default stop setting enabled, an unanswered review-loop question receives an automatic narrow choice after 30 minutes. The new plan update runs only for an explicit `--resolve` choice here. `check_stop` instead calls `_answer_by_default` (close.py:550–551), which records the choice and starts follow-up fixes without updating or merging the story plan. The resumed worker therefore sees the old builder details. The named plan test covers explicit choices, but not this normal default-choice path.
